description: Search Animal Math's free printables (worksheet packs, unit tests, exit tickets, lesson plans), worksheet makers, quizzes and teaching tools for Pre-K to 5th grade by topic words, grade, kind or a standard code. Each result has its page link and its set item for make_set_link; quizzes list their levels. Use it before giving any Animal Math link.

grade.description: A grade: pk, k, 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 ("kindergarten" and "3rd grade" work too).

kind.description: Only this kind. A printable is a ready-made PDF pack; a maker (worksheet generator) draws new sheets with chosen settings.

query.description: Topic words as a teacher says them: "subtraction with regrouping", "telling time to the half hour", "fractions on a number line".

standard.description: A standard's code: 1.OA.C.6 (Common Core), 3.4A (Texas TEKS), MA.2.NSO.2.1 (Florida B.E.S.T.), AC9M2N06 (Australian Curriculum), Y2.M.9 (England, our numbering of its National Curriculum), NZ.Y2.N.3 (New Zealand, our numbering of its curriculum), 3.B1.2 (Ontario); Virginia, Georgia, Indiana, Oklahoma, South Carolina and codes of the other Canadian provinces too.

standard_set.description: The set a code is from, when it could be more than one: common core, texas, florida, virginia, georgia, indiana, oklahoma, south carolina, australia, england, new zealand, or a Canadian province (ontario, british columbia, alberta, ...).
